aboutHeading: No decisions made in the chair
about:
Nobody makes a good decision about money while they are lying back with a bib on. That is why the plan and the price go to you in writing, and why you get to take them home.

If something can wait, we will tell you it can wait. If it cannot, you will understand exactly why before you agree to anything.

Cosmetic work especially — veneers, whitening, aligners — is elective. There is never a reason to rush you into it.
points: A written treatment plan, with the price on it
What needs doing now, and what can safely wait
Your insurance checked before you commit, not after
Payment plans discussed openly, not at the desk on the way out
A second opinion is always welcome — bring your X-rays
